Golf Course Corner Lot — Move in ready, or Renovate & Expand to Build Your Dream Home!
A rare opportunity to keep as is or create your dream home on a 0.34-acre corner lot (100' x 150') directly across from Bartlett Country Club — just steps from the No. 9 green and No. 10 tee, on a quiet golf course facing street.    The existing 1,108 sq ft home (2 bed/2 bath, built 1941) offers a solid foundation to renovate and expand, with a detached garage, partial basement, and driveway already in place. Now vacant and move-in ready to live or start work immediately, this generous corner lot leaves plenty of room to add on, reconfigure, or reimagine the layout — capturing golf-course frontage that rarely becomes available.    Bring your vision and make this golf-course corner lot your own.
